description: Get the full listing for one legal AI tool by its slug, including the complete description and MCP install command. Use after search_legal_ai_tools to go deeper on a specific result.

slug.description: Listing slug, e.g. "harvey-ai" — taken from a search result

name: get_legal_ai_tool

found.description: False when no published listing has this slug

tool.description: The listing, present when found is true

connection.description: Reviewed setup documentation, not a compatibility or security test. Null means no reviewed setup guide is attached, not that a connector cannot exist.

install_command.description: MCP install command, if the tool ships an MCP server

links_verified.description: True if an automated check confirmed every URL on this listing resolved, as of links_verified_at. An automated link check only — NOT an endorsement, security audit, or legal review.

links_verified_at.description: ISO date of the last passing link check; null = not confirmed (often just bot-blocking)

pricing_model.description: One of: free, freemium, paid, contact

slug.description: Stable listing identifier — pass to get_legal_ai_tool

source_review.description: Dated primary-source review for the matching published claims. This is not a runtime, security or legal-output test.

verification.description: LegalAIMCP is not the vendor. What we checked, when, and how to repeat each check without us.

checked_at.description: Date the checks were run; null when this listing has not been checked yet.

checks.description: What we observed, each with a command you can run to see it too. unknown means the check could not be run, not that it failed.

independent.description: Always true: LegalAIMCP is an independent directory, not the vendor of any listed tool.

not_checked.description: What we did not do. A passing check is not a recommendation.

operator.description: The operator as found in a public company register, or a not_found note. Null means no register lookup is on record.

title: Get one legal AI tool
